name: ref-breakglass-any-signin
displayName: REF - Break-glass account used (any sign-in, any device)
description: Any interactive or non-interactive sign-in attempt by the emergency-access account ea01, or any Windows logon by it on any workstation. Added 12 Oct 2026 (RA-027): the Purview break-glass policy sees interactive sign-ins only and missed the 10 Oct Windows sign-in, which reached Entra as non-interactive sign-ins. Every use must be recorded with its reason (PLN-007). NIST 3.1.5, 3.3.1, 3.6.1.

criteria.query:
let bg = dynamic(["ea01@example.onmicrosoft.com"]);
union isfuzzy=true
 (SigninLogs | where ingestion_time() > ago(6m) | where UserPrincipalName in~ (bg) | extend D = parse_json(tostring(DeviceDetail)), L = parse_json(tostring(LocationDetails)) | project TimeGenerated, Kind = "interactive sign-in", App = AppDisplayName, IPAddress, Place = strcat(tostring(L.city), ", ", tostring(L.countryOrRegion)), Device = tostring(D.displayName), Result = tostring(ResultType)),
 (AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs | where ingestion_time() > ago(6m) | where UserPrincipalName in~ (bg) | extend D = parse_json(tostring(DeviceDetail)), L = parse_json(tostring(LocationDetails)) | project TimeGenerated, Kind = "non-interactive sign-in", App = AppDisplayName, IPAddress, Place = strcat(tostring(L.city), ", ", tostring(L.countryOrRegion)), Device = tostring(D.displayName), Result = tostring(ResultType)),
 (SecurityEvent | where ingestion_time() > ago(6m) | where EventID in (4624, 4625, 4648) | where TargetUserName has "ea01" | project TimeGenerated, Kind = strcat("Windows logon event ", EventID), App = LogonProcessName, IPAddress = IpAddress, Place = Computer, Device = Computer, Result = tostring(Status))
| summarize Events = count(), First = min(TimeGenerated), Last = max(TimeGenerated), Kinds = make_set(Kind), Apps = make_set(App, 10), IPs = make_set(IPAddress, 5), Places = make_set(Place, 5), Devices = make_set(Device, 5)
| where Events > 0
| extend Problem = strcat("Break-glass account ea01 used: ", Events, " sign-in event(s) ", tostring(Kinds), " on ", tostring(Devices), " from ", tostring(IPs), ". Every use must be recorded with its reason (PLN-007); if it was not you, treat as an incident now.")
